title: 電気磁気学Ⅰ
subtitle: Electromagnetics I
keywords: Charge and coulomb force 2.Electric field and electric potential 3.Capacitance of conductor system 4.Dielectric material 5.Online/ On-demand class
educationalGoal: The learning and educational goal is to acquire basic knowledge of electricity and to acquire basic electrical and electronic abilities that can be applied to specific problems through physical and mathematical considerations. Students will acquire the basic mathematics necessary for analyzing various physical phenomena in "electromagnetism", the basic rules regarding electric charges, electric fields, potentials, and capacitances in electrostatic fields, and the ability to solve problems of electrostatic fields.
advice: The class covers the following items. Chapter 1 : Charge and Coulomb force (Phenomenon to charge, charge and properties, conductor and nonconductor, electrostatic induction, Coulomb's law, Coulomb force, Coulomb force and plane coordinates, composition of multiple Coulomb forces in plane coordinates, Coulomb force and space coordinates) Chapter 2 : Electric field and electric potential (electric field, synthetic electric field by multiple electric charges, synthetic electric field by electric charge distributed continuously, electric field lines, small area passing, lines of electric force, potential, potential due to multiple charges, equipotential surface, spatial representation of potential, Gauss's law and its application) Chapter 3 : Capacitance of conductor system (the nature of charged conductor, capacitance, capacitance of various conductor systems, electric imaging method, contact of capacitor, Energy of the capacitor) Chapter 4 : Dielectrics (Dielectric properties, polarization, electric field and electric flux density in dielectric, electric field and electric flux density in two dielectrics, conduction with dielectric energy stored between bodies, force between conductors filled with dielectrics) Chapter 5 : Current (Transfer of charge, ohm's law, resistance and resistor, conductance and conductivity, Joule heat and power, electric field in conductor, current density) If necessary, learning may take place using digital methods such as online (distance) or on-demand classes.
books: Textbook,A.Mikami, M.Masahiko, S.Makino, Y.Fujita, H.Yanagibashi,"Basic electromgnetics Ⅰ", Kanazawa Institute of Technology,(2026)
requiredKnowledge: This class is an introductory subject of "electromagnetics", and it is planned to take "electromagnetics II" and "electromagnetics III". So, the following background knowledge and skills are required. 1. Review the basic mathematics such as functions and graphs, trigonometric functions, vector analysis. 2. In electromagnetics, many new "units" are used. Understand the main units of physical quantities and the configuration of unit systems. 3. Be aware of the definitions and key formulas of technical terms.

activityGoals.body: The nature of charge, the Coulomb law acting between charges can be understood.
Understanding the relationship between electric field and potential formed by charge, and using Gauss's law.
The basic problem of the capacitance of a conductor system, electrostatic energy can be solved.
Understanding the electrical polarization of dielectrics.
